external.description: Siri in macOS 27 Golden Gate is significantly improved and no longer defaults to handing off questions to ChatGPT. Users can still access ChatGPT for specific queries by explicitly asking for it. Unlike previous macOS versions where Siri would suggest ChatGPT, now ChatGPT only responds when directly invoked. There is no setting to make ChatGPT the default assistant, requiring manual selection for each query. To enable the ChatGPT extension, navigate to System Settings, click Siri, select ChatGPT under "Extension," and turn on "Use Extension." Users can choose to sign in with a ChatGPT account, which saves requests to their chat history, or skip sign-in for enhanced privacy. To ask ChatGPT, open Search or Ask, right-click the field, and select "Use ChatGPT." After a question is answered, the system reverts to Siri AI unless further follow-up questions are needed. Alternatively, users can start a spoken Siri request with "ask ChatGPT" or type the same phrase into the Search or Ask field. Currently, ChatGPT is the sole AI provider available in Golden Gate, though future updates may include others like Claude.
external.title: Switch Siri AI for ChatGPT on Your Mac
